name: otelcol.receiver.filelog

arguments.name: include
arguments.description: A list of glob patterns to include files.

arguments.name: acquire_fs_lock
arguments.description: Whether to acquire a file system lock while reading the file (Unix only).

arguments.name: attributes
arguments.description: A map of attributes to add to each log entry.

arguments.name: compression
arguments.description: The compression type used for the log file.

arguments.name: delete_after_read
arguments.description: Whether to delete the file after reading.

arguments.name: encoding
arguments.description: The encoding of the log file.

arguments.name: exclude_older_than
arguments.description: Exclude files with a modification time older than the specified duration.

arguments.name: exclude
arguments.description: A list of glob patterns to exclude files that would be included by the include patterns.

arguments.name: fingerprint_size
arguments.description: The size of the fingerprint used to detect file changes.

arguments.name: force_flush_period
arguments.description: The period after which logs are flushed even if the buffer isn’t full.

arguments.name: include_file_name_resolved
arguments.description: Whether to include the resolved filename in the log entry.

arguments.description: Whether to include the filename in the log entry.

arguments.name: include_file_owner_group_name
arguments.description: Whether to include the file owner’s group name in the log entry.

arguments.description: Whether to include the file owner’s name in the log entry.

arguments.name: include_file_path_resolved
arguments.description: Whether to include the resolved file path in the log entry.

arguments.name: include_file_path
arguments.description: Whether to include the file path in the log entry.

arguments.name: include_file_record_number
arguments.description: Whether to include the file record number in the log entry.

arguments.name: max_batches
arguments.description: The maximum number of batches to process concurrently.

arguments.name: max_concurrent_files
arguments.description: The maximum number of files to read concurrently.

arguments.name: max_log_size
arguments.description: The maximum size of a log entry.

arguments.name: operators
arguments.description: A list of operators used to parse the log entries.

arguments.description: The interval at which the file is polled for new entries.

arguments.description: Preserves leading whitespace in messages when set to true.

arguments.name: preserve_trailing_whitespaces
arguments.description: Preserves trailing whitespace in messages when set to true.
